## Quantitative / Computational Methods

Pattern recognition and computational intelligence (prototype-based classifiers, differential evolution and other optimization methods); data engineering and ETL; Python; workflow orchestration (Airflow); containerized deployment (Kubernetes); business intelligence and data visualization (Power BI); relational databases and data architecture/quality; and, as part of my current research transition, agent-based modeling and introductory network analysis.
